steps: Chromatin is a network of fine threads present in the nucleus.
During cell division, chromatin threads condense and become visible as chromosomes.
Nerve cells, also called neurons, send nerve signals.
Mesophyll cells contain chloroplasts and carry out photosynthesis in plant leaves.
A stem cell is an undifferentiated cell that can divide and develop into specialized cell types.
items.finalAnswer: A stem cell is an undifferentiated cell that can form specialized cells.

steps: The cell membrane is made mainly of lipids and proteins.
The fungal cell wall is made of chitin.
The plant cell wall is made of cellulose.
The bacterial cell wall is made of peptidoglycan (murein).
